questions.q: Our developers ___ going to fix the bug today.
questions.explainRo: Developers este la plural, deci folosim are going to.

questions.q: I'm going to ___ my grandmother this weekend.
questions.explainRo: După going to verbul stă la forma de bază: visit.

options: The team going to finish the project in May.
The team is going finish the project in May.
The team is going to finish the project in May.
questions.explainRo: Avem nevoie și de to be (is), și de to: is going to + verb.

questions.q: Sorry, I can't meet you on Tuesday – I have a doctor's ___ at eleven.
The ___ for the new website is Friday, so we're working late this week.
questions.explainRo: Deadline = termen limită; de aceea lucrăm până târziu săptămâna aceasta.
Nunta e deja stabilită, deci folosim prezentul continuu: is getting (sau is going to get).

questions.q: Mark ___ (not / cancel) his trip to Japan. He really wants to go.
questions.explainRo: Negația cu going to: isn't going to + verbul la forma de bază.

questions.q: We want to ___ a table for four at eight o'clock.
questions.explainRo: Book = a rezerva (o masă, o cameră de hotel, un bilet).

questions.ro: Unde mergi în vacanță anul acesta?
questions.explainRo: Prezentul continuu pentru planuri: Where are you going...? (fără „going to go”).

questions.ro: Cine o să trimită ordinea de zi?
questions.explainRo: Întrebare cu going to: Who + is going to + verb?

questions.audio: Are you coming to the party on Friday?
answers: Are you coming to the party on Friday?
questions.explainRo: Prezentul continuu (Are you coming...?) întreabă despre un plan stabilit.

answers: When are you going to launch the app?
When are you launching the app?
When will you launch the app?
